items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Judaism is closes to it. You know it’s the same thing actually because Ishmael and who’s the other one — the brothers of Abraham and his two sons.

ctx.x: What it is, it was the idea, the clarity of the oneness of God you know. To me God is singular you know. And I had no partners, and Christianity — well Judaism is that way. They, you know, it’s just God that’s it. But Christianity got three Gods. Now they say it’s one God but in three parts you know. And then the one part is his son, one part is the holy spirit. But I don’t think the almighty God would need a son you know. What do you need a son for you’re almighty and merciful. The almighty, he’s perfectly…

the average human being but it ain’t greater, it’s far, far away from it you know, the way I look at it. And when he says well he made man in his own image I say, “Yeah man got an image of his own” so you know he made man in his own image, not in his image, not in my image. I don’t have no image you know. If I had an image how could you compose it in a human being? You mean to tell me the guy that made Venus, whoever made Venus, Pluto, Neptune, Mars, and Andromeda, the galaxy, has got two hands and two eyes and a…
